the development of a mobile app for a marketing campaign and the evaluation of customer purchase behavior.
the design of a marketing campaign application for increasing customer purchase intentions.

we developed a mobile app for supporting a marketing campaign, and we successfully demonstrated how gamification mechanics can be used in marketing campaigns.
the proposed framework and the developed mobile application could be applied in other marketing campaigns and in other types of businesses.

the systematic framework for Internet marketing is useful for guiding the development of gamification mechanics in a mobile app.
